map.→ 打开损耗（控制/分析/改善）体系工具: -> Open the Loss (control / analysis / improvement) System tool
map.两车间损耗稳定性对比: Loss Stability Comparison Between Two Workshops
map.出现负值是什么情况？: What Does a Negative Value Mean?
map.对比两个车间的损耗数据，用均值与标准差判断哪个环节更不稳定。: Compare the loss data of two workshops and use the mean and the standard deviation to judge which is less stable.
map.建议按生产周期（周或月）固定窗口统计，窗口固定后数据才可跨期比较。: It is recommended to compute with a fixed window per production cycle (weekly or monthly), since the data can only be compared across periods once the window is fixed.
map.把各批次损耗数量贴入，统计损耗率与波动，识别损耗异常偏高的批次。: Paste in the loss quantities for each batch, compute the loss rate and the fluctuation, and identify batches with abnormally high loss.
map.损耗率怎么算？: How Is the Loss Rate Computed?
map.汇总月度损耗，看趋势是收敛还是发散，评估改善措施是否见效。: Aggregate the monthly losses and see whether the trend is converging or diverging, to assess whether the improvement measures work.
map.负数可能来自盘盈或录入错误；若为真实盘盈可保留，但需在备注中说明，避免误判为异常: A negative value may come from a stock surplus or a data entry error; if it is a real surplus you can keep it, but note it in the remarks to avoid misjudging it as an anomaly.
map.输入损耗数量与基准数据（逗号或换行分隔），统计损耗率、均值与波动，辅助损耗控制与: Enter the loss quantities and the baseline data (separated by commas or newlines) to compute the loss rate, the mean, and the fluctuation, supporting loss control and improvement analysis.
map.页面统计的是你输入的数值本身；建议先把各项统一换算为损耗率（损耗量÷投入量）再贴: The page computes on the values you enter; it is recommended to first convert every item to a loss rate (loss amount ÷ input amount) before pasting, so that they can be compared horizontally.
map.：A 车间损耗 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.0 / 2.2（均值 2.15，标准: : Workshop A losses 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.0 / 2.2 (mean 2.15, standard deviation 0.11), workshop B 1.5 / 3.8 / 1.2 / 3.1 (mean 2.4, standard deviation 1.05); the means are close but B fluctuates nearly 10 times as much, so B's process control is unstable and the improvement should focus on stability rather than simply lowering the mean.
